object_context: First spectral/operator obstruction for the Riemann Hypothesis: isolate a non-circular, mathematically exact bridge from the unconditional arithmetic explicit formula to a Hilbert-space/operator or quadratic-form statement whose proved self-adjointness/positivity and exact spectral/arithmetic correspondence would force Weil's RH-equivalent sign condition or, equivalently, reality of all zeros of the completed xi function.
structural_coordinates: the completed xi function is entire and RH is equivalent to all of its zeros in the t-variable being real
Weil's explicit formula pairs a sum over zeta zeros with prime-power and archimedean terms on an admissible test-function class

Weil's criterion turns RH into a global sign condition for a convolution-derived quadratic functional, so positivity/negativity is a load-bearing exact bridge rather than a heuristic spectral statistic

a Hilbert-Polya route needs both a legitimate self-adjoint operator and an exact correspondence between its full relevant spectrum and the zeta zero ordinates, including multiplicity and no missing/spurious spectral contributions
any trace-formula route must specify its test-function domain, convergence or distributional meaning, continuous-spectrum terms, regularization, and all correction terms before spectral inference
the finite-field analogue has an actual cohomology theory and Frobenius operator; Deligne's theorem supplies the missing spectral-size control there
the Selberg trace formula is a solved spectral-geometric analogue with an independently defined self-adjoint Laplacian and a geometric side; its arithmetic weights are not the Riemann prime weights
Berry-Keating-type H=xp models match mean/asymptotic spectral features only unless a quantum domain, self-adjoint extension, exact arithmetic trace, and zero correspondence are proved
Connes' adelic noncommutative framework gives a serious trace/absorption representation, but the load-bearing validity/positivity step cannot be assumed from the formal analogy
random-matrix statistics, zero-counting asymptotics, and finite zero verification are calibration data only and cannot establish the exact root statement
equivalent_formulations: every nontrivial zero rho of zeta(s) satisfies Re(rho)=1/2
every zero of Xi(t)=xi(1/2+it) is real
Weil's RH-equivalent explicit-formula quadratic sign condition holds on the full registered admissible test-function class
a sufficient spectral bridge is an independently defined self-adjoint operator whose complete relevant spectrum equals the multiset of zeta zero ordinates under an exact correspondence

a sufficient positivity bridge is an unconditional exact factorization of the RH-equivalent Weil quadratic functional as a sign-definite Hilbert-space norm or positive-operator quadratic form on the full admissible domain
solved_analogues: Weil conjectures over finite fields: zeros are controlled through an independently defined cohomology theory and Frobenius action, with the Riemann-Hypothesis part proved by Deligne
Selberg trace formula: an independently defined self-adjoint Laplacian has a rigorous spectral side exactly related to a geometric closed-orbit side for suitable test functions
near_solved_analogues: Connes 1999 adelic/noncommutative trace-formula programme interprets critical zeros through an absorption spectrum and reduces RH to a remaining trace-formula validity problem

Berry-Keating 1999 H=xp semiclassical programme reproduces leading zero-counting structure and prime-orbit heuristics but does not provide the required exact self-adjoint arithmetic spectral realization
de Bruijn-Newman heat-flow theory gives a rigorous real-zero deformation boundary; Rodgers-Tao prove the Newman constant is nonnegative while RH is equivalent to the opposite bound Lambda<=0

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A system is certified passive or stable by representing its input-output work as a nonnegative energy or Gram quadratic form generated by an independently defined state map; the sign follows from Hilbert-space geometry once the exact energy identity is proved.
common_abstraction: global sign condition over an admissible input class
exact transform maps inputs to a state space
quadratic functional equals a Hilbert norm or positive-operator form
positivity is structural after the identity, while the identity itself carries the domain-specific burden
source_to_target_mapping: admissible system input -> Weil admissible test function g
energy/work quadratic functional -> RH-equivalent Weil explicit-formula quadratic functional
state/response transform -> arithmetic-to-Hilbert-space transform or operator representation
nonnegative stored/dissipated energy -> sign-definite Hilbert norm or positive-operator quadratic form
shared_constraints: the identity must hold for the full registered input/test-function class
the transform and state space must be defined without assuming the desired sign
null spaces and boundary terms must be accounted for explicitly
positivity alone is useless if the exact target functional is not represented
disanalogies: physical passivity usually comes from a causal dynamical law already known, whereas the arithmetic transform/state space is precisely what is missing
the Weil functional includes prime-power and archimedean terms with arithmetic structure that a generic energy model does not reproduce
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Search for an unconditional exact factorization of the RH-equivalent Weil quadratic functional as a sign-definite Hilbert-space norm or positive-operator form, and reject any factorization whose domain, kernel, boundary condition, or regularization assumes the desired zero location.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Derive the exact equality from the unconditional Weil explicit formula on the exact admissible test-function class; prove the transform/operator is well defined and the relevant form is closable or otherwise rigorous; prove positivity independently of RH; account for null spaces, prime-power terms, archimedean terms, and moment constraints; and falsify the proposed identity on tractable test functions and solved trace-formula analogues before any root inference.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Structural analogy to passivity/energy and Gram-factorization proofs. It is proposal guidance only and supplies no evidence for RH.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned arithmetic geometry, hyperbolic trace formulas, noncommutative geometry, semiclassical quantum chaos, real-zero heat flows, operator positivity, and cross-domain energy/passivity proofs. Retained the energy/Gram-factorization bridge because it directly targets Weil's exact sign criterion while making circularity and exact-identity obligations falsifiable.
